paragraphs.text: Revenue from operations for {{p:2026-04}} stood at {{m:revenue@2026-04}}, up {{mv:revenue.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:revenue.mom@2026-04:pct}}) from the prior month, but down {{mv:revenue.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:revenue.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) compared with the same month last year.

Profit before tax was {{m:pbt@2026-04}}, a decrease of {{mv:pbt.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:pbt.mom@2026-04:pct}}) month-on-month and a decrease of {{mv:pbt.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:pbt.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year. Profit after tax matched profit before tax at {{m:pat@2026-04}}, moving by the same amounts and percentages, indicating no tax charge was recorded for the month.

Direct costs rose sharply to {{m:direct_costs@2026-04}}, up {{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:pct}}) from the prior month and up {{mv:direct_costs.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:direct_costs.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) from the same month last year.

Gross profit was {{m:gross_profit@2026-04}}, down {{mv:gross_profit.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:gross_profit.mom@2026-04:pct}}) month-on-month and down {{mv:gross_profit.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:gross_profit.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year. EBITDA followed a similar pattern, falling to {{m:ebitda@2026-04}}, a decrease of {{mv:ebitda.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:ebitda.mom@2026-04:pct}}) on the prior month and {{mv:ebitda.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:ebitda.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) on the same month last year.

Other income was {{m:other_income@2026-04}}, down {{mv:other_income.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:other_income.mom@2026-04:pct}}) from the prior month, with no comparable change recorded against the same month last year. Depreciation was {{m:depreciation@2026-04}}, down {{mv:depreciation.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:depreciation.mom@2026-04:pct}}) month-on-month but up {{mv:depreciation.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:depreciation.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year.

Trade receivables stood at {{m:receivables@2026-04}}, broadly stable against the prior month (up {{mv:receivables.mom@2026-04:abs}}, or {{mv:receivables.mom@2026-04:pct}}) but up {{mv:receivables.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:receivables.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year. Trade payables were {{m:payables@2026-04}}, up {{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:pct}}) from the prior month and up {{mv:payables.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:payables.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) from the same month last year.

Cash and bank balances were {{m:cash_and_bank@2026-04}}, up {{mv:cash_and_bank.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:cash_and_bank.mom@2026-04:pct}}) month-on-month and up {{mv:cash_and_bank.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:cash_and_bank.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year. Overall working capital was {{m:working_capital@2026-04}}, an increase of {{mv:working_capital.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:working_capital.mom@2026-04:pct}}) on the prior month and {{mv:working_capital.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:working_capital.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) on the same month last year.

output.summary: Direct costs surged against flat revenue this month, dragging gross profit and EBITDA down sharply year-on-year; payables also jumped, warranting a closer look at cost drivers and supplier terms.

actions.heading: Investigate the direct cost spike
actions.because: Direct costs rose {{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:pct}} month-on-month ({{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:abs}}) while revenue grew only {{mv:revenue.mom@2026-04:pct}}, pulling gross profit down {{mv:gross_profit.mom@2026-04:pct}} and EBITDA down {{mv:ebitda.mom@2026-04:pct}}.
actions.todo: Ask the finance team to break down {{m:direct_costs@2026-04}} by component and confirm whether this is a one-off or a cost base shift before next month's close.

actions.heading: Review the year-on-year profitability decline
actions.because: PAT fell {{mv:pat.yoy@2026-04:pct}} year-on-year ({{mv:pat.yoy@2026-04:abs}}) and revenue fell {{mv:revenue.yoy@2026-04:pct}} against the same month last year.
actions.todo: Have management prepare a comparison of volumes/pricing versus last year to identify whether the decline is demand-led or cost-led.

actions.heading: Check payables growth against supplier terms
actions.because: Trade payables rose {{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:pct}} on the month ({{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:abs}}) and {{mv:payables.yoy@2026-04:pct}} on the year, while receivables moved only {{mv:receivables.mom@2026-04:pct}}.
actions.todo: Ask the accountant to confirm payable ageing and whether terms have changed with suppliers, to avoid a build-up of overdue balances.

actions.heading: Confirm disappearance of other income
actions.because: Other income fell to {{m:other_income@2026-04}}, a drop of {{mv:other_income.mom@2026-04:pct}} on last month.
actions.todo: Check with the accountant whether this reflects a genuine stoppage of income or a timing/recognition issue.

actions.heading: Monitor large cash balance for deployment
actions.because: Cash and bank stands at {{m:cash_and_bank@2026-04}}, up {{mv:cash_and_bank.yoy@2026-04:pct}} year-on-year, alongside working capital of {{m:working_capital@2026-04}}.
actions.todo: Ask the board to review whether idle cash should be placed in interest-bearing instruments or deployed, in consultation with the bank.
